items.item: The page header has a plural title and at most one primary action; other actions such as export sit in a secondary position
items.evidence:
Equipment List

is a singular 'List' title; header has no actions at all (no primary action, no export).

items.item: The table appears in the first viewport, with search and 2–3 visible filters (such as location and status) and no row of KPI cards above it
items.evidence: Table starts at y=250 with search + status + area selects, but a 4-tile KPI row (#summary: Total machines, Fault, Inspections overdue, Due within 14 days) sits above it.

items.item: By default the list is ordered with overdue inspections first, then inspections due soon, then the rest
items.evidence: sortKey='next' ascending: first.png shows Overdue (28 Oct, 02 Nov, 04 Nov), then Due in 5/7/13 days, then In 17+ days.

items.item: Overdue and due-soon inspections are marked with a text label (such as "Overdue" or "Due in 7 days"), not by colour alone
items.evidence: nextCell() renders 'Overdue by N days' / 'Due in N days' text under the date.

items.item: Dates are absolute and consistently formatted, and every row has a human-readable equipment code
items.evidence: fmt() en-GB '05 Nov 2026' for all dates; Equipment ID column EQ-1001..EQ-1016.

items.item: Status tabs or a summary line show counts (such as "Overdue 4")
items.evidence: Summary tiles show 'Inspections overdue 3', 'Due within 14 days 3', 'Fault 2' plus 'Showing N of 16 machines'; not tabs or filters, and implemented as KPI cards.

items.item: Rows are single-line, and row actions show at most two visible controls, with icon-only controls having accessible names
items.evidence: audit.json rows: double 16, single 0 (date + note stacked in two lines, ~61px rows). There are no row actions at all.

items.item: A filter combination with no matches shows a no-results state with a clear-filters action, distinct from the first-use empty state; a loading state and an error state with retry are present
items.evidence: #empty says 'No equipment matches the current filters.' with no clear-filters button; no first-use empty state, no loading state, no error/retry (data is hardcoded).

items.item: Interactive targets are at least 24×24px, and text and status contrast meets 4.5:1
items.evidence: audit.json smallTargets 0 and 130 text nodes contrast-checked with no violations.

notes: Audit score 92 with violations uppercase-text x6 and table-row-two-line. KPI tiles are plain (no icons or deltas) so kpi-icon-tiles not listed. Page has no row actions, no primary action, no loading/error states, and no clear-filters action.
